terms: الذكاء الاصطناعي والتحليلات;الذكاء الاصطناعي ومساعدو المتجر
reading: extension-point: the Zid App Market has a category of its own, الذكاء الاصطناعي والتحليلات (AI and analytics), with a subcategory الذكاء الاصطناعي ومساعدو المتجر (AI and store assistants) (ZD-I-0430, ZD-I-0431, inventory entries Q1 placed in ZD-C-070; no statement holds them). shows: Zid's AI processing occurs only after the user's explicit in-app consent (ZD-S-0797, of ZD-C-042, domain A, which names F); Zid Voice is AI that communicates on the merchant's behalf (ZD-S-1070, of ZD-C-112, domain C, which names F). Zid Voice's own place, Orders > Zid Voice (ZD-S-1067), is domain C's abandoned-cart recovery and is left to it, so this cell places nothing of Zid's own AI here; Zid's own AI agent is in the child CM-AIA-002.

terms: وكيل زد;Zid Agent;المحفظة الرقمية الخاصة بوكيل زد
reading: core: Zid's own service وكيل زد (Zid Agent): the merchant tops up the Zid Agent's digital wallet to use its features (ZD-S-0713), needs an active store on Zid (ZD-S-0714), and the Zid platform provides the service directly or through its partners and external technology providers (ZD-S-0716). outside: Google Cloud Vertex AI, as data processor, powers its AI-assisted features, including product research, store optimization, campaign management and conversational assistance (ZD-S-0717). shows: its terms (ZD-I-0414) and the two-hour window to ask for a refund of a wallet top-up (ZD-S-0715, a quality). That the agent works inside the admin isn't stated (landings, strained). Q1's gap: no reason found for the wallet and its refund window (searched, not found).

The hits for agent and وكيل are Zid Agent, the merchant's AI agent (CM-AIA-002), a voice agent calling buyers about abandoned carts (Zid Voice, ZD-S-0452, domain C), and a device agent's warranty (ZD-S-0981): none is buyers' agents (Q1's homonym U-062, AI assistants against agentic commerce).

core: Zid's own API: every request into its system must be authorized, usually with the Authorization and X-Manager-Token headers (ZD-S-0875), a convention common to the API; and Zid's stated part in connecting a store to external systems is providing the APIs and connection tools (ZD-S-0892, of ZD-C-074, landed in CM-APP-009). The API's resources are documented in groups named Merchant APIs > ..., each with a feature's own API (such as ZD-S-0615, ZD-S-0024), cited in their features' domains; no Zid statement found defines the API as a whole, or names its base URL.

core: Zid's own OAuth server, whose base URL https://oauth.zid.sa handles app authentication (ZD-S-0869); the merchant sees the scopes the application requests and approves or declines them (ZD-S-0870). shows: Zid's App Activation & OAuth Policy (ZD-I-0425), which says never to ask merchants to paste Zid access or refresh tokens, manager tokens, API keys, client secrets or passwords into the app (ZD-S-0873), and keeps a partner-managed setup path for apps whose service needs preparation before a store can be connected (ZD-S-0877, under reason, read as the path's own terms).

core: Zid's own scopes: the App Market supports many scopes requested from the merchant, which the developer selects on the application's page in the Partner Dashboard (ZD-S-0871), each with a justification for the review team that approves them (ZD-S-0872). shows: request only the scopes the app's documented functionality needs (ZD-S-0874); the stated reason, that scopes define access levels letting merchants control what data the app can access (ZD-S-0876). Zid's scopes themselves (such as webhooks.read_write, products.read_write) are listed with the features they reach, cited in their domains.

Zid's webhook topics are its features' own, cited in their domains; its app topics are in CM-APP-004.

terms: سوق تطبيقات زد;Zid App Market;App Market categories;Public apps;Submit for Review;manage.app.market.details
reading: core: Zid's own App Market, a platform owned by Zid that connects the merchant's store to the apps it offers (ZD-S-0861); public apps are listed there for all merchants to view and install (ZD-S-0862); Zid's team reviews and tests an app before publishing it (ZD-S-0863), tests and audits apps before launch while guaranteeing no third party (ZD-S-0867), and may return, reject, suspend or remove an app that doesn't comply (ZD-S-0864); its staff permissions manage.app.market.details, Manage app market details / purchase subscription (ZD-S-0467), view.app.market.home and view.app.market.browse, browse apps by category (ZD-I-0503, ZD-I-0538). extension-point: its app categories, such as المالية والمدفوعات (category id 19, ZD-S-0422), العمليات وإدارة المتجر and التسويق والنمو (ZD-I-0442, ZD-I-0455), and public apps in Zid's list of extension points (ZD-I-0540). shows: the App Market's terms (ZD-I-0417). Q1's gap: no reason found for placing apps with independent partners (searched, not found).

reading: core: payment for an app goes through Zid: any required app-plan payment is completed through Zid before activation (ZD-S-0684), and a standard app keeps its charges within the applicable Zid plans, with no other partner-side payment (ZD-S-0685); Zid's own API group App Management > APIs (ZD-I-0045), with the endpoints Subscription Details, for a merchant's app subscription, plan, status and billing (ZD-S-0690), and Update Usage-Based Charges, for a usage-based plan's outstanding balance (ZD-S-0691). shows: where Zid collects a service's activation fee from the merchant, it does so as merchant and partner agree, and Zid, merely a technical tool, answers for no claim, refund or change of fee (ZD-S-0688). Q1's gap: no reason found for Zid collecting app payments (searched, not found).
